hard_calls: The 'Pragmatism is uncomfortable...' / 'Rationalism is comfortable...' pair is kept as its own short note rather than merged into the hailstorm note or the objective-truth note.
'He accuses us' stays with the preceding rationalist statement, since 'He' has no repairing source name otherwise.
'Such truths' / 'Such tests' / 'As against this' keep the whole rationalist account of objective truth in one note.
The ultra-abstractionist sentence is split off alone; it stands without a referent.
